Q1.decision: First provider ElevenLabs; Provider interface ready for OpenAI (or others) as second implementation without API redesign.
Q1.question: Which TTS provider ships first?
Q1.rec: First provider ElevenLabs; Provider interface ready for OpenAI (or others) as second implementation without API redesign.

Q2.decision: p1 = on-demand POST /api/sessions/{id}/tts plus client prefetch of next phase; eager_on_wonderstand_turn defaults false.
Q2.question: Synth trigger in p1: on-demand only vs eager at end of turn?
Q2.rec: p1 = on-demand POST /api/sessions/{id}/tts plus client prefetch of next phase; eager_on_wonderstand_turn defaults false.

Q3.decision: p1 config via JSON file and/or process flags (plus env secret); Settings UI toggle/status can follow once core works.
Q3.question: Config surface for p1?
Q3.rec: p1 config via JSON file and/or process flags (plus env secret); Settings UI toggle/status can follow once core works.

Q4.decision: Do not fill phase.audio on turn complete by default; optional config eager_on_wonderstand_turn for Wonderstand sessions later (M4).
Q4.question: Should harness eagerly write phase.audio after assistant presentation is ready?
Q4.rec: Do not fill phase.audio on turn complete by default; optional config eager_on_wonderstand_turn for Wonderstand sessions later (M4).

Q5.decision: Allow TTS while session busy — synthesize does not start an agent turn; concurrent with tools/model.
Q5.question: Allow POST …/tts while session is busy?
Q5.rec: Allow TTS while session busy — synthesize does not start an agent turn; concurrent with tools/model.

Q6.decision: Attachment GET serves audio/* inline (playable); extend ADR-0019 safe GET allowlist for audio/mpeg, wav, ogg, mp4, webm.
Q6.question: How should attachment GET treat audio MIME?
Q6.rec: Attachment GET serves audio/* inline (playable); extend ADR-0019 safe GET allowlist for audio/mpeg, wav, ogg, mp4, webm.

Q7.decision: No presentation protocol_version bump for phase.audio — additive optional field; old clients ignore unknown keys; speech_text remains required.
Q7.question: Bump ADR-0025 protocol_version for phase.audio?
Q7.rec: No presentation protocol_version bump for phase.audio — additive optional field; old clients ignore unknown keys; speech_text remains required.

Q8.decision: Cache: content hash → session attachment; optional global $MEMORY/tts-cache for cross-session reuse of same hash.
Q8.question: TTS cache scope?
Q8.rec: Cache: content hash → session attachment; optional global $MEMORY/tts-cache for cross-session reuse of same hash.

Q9.decision: Default ElevenLabs model tier = Flash (low latency) for immersion; allow Quality/multilingual model + voice override in config.
Q9.question: ElevenLabs default model tier (Flash vs higher quality)?
Q9.rec: Default ElevenLabs model tier = Flash (low latency) for immersion; allow Quality/multilingual model + voice override in config.

Q10.decision: Any authenticated session client may call POST …/tts; Wonderstand is primary UX but API is not wonderstand-only.
Q10.question: Who may call the TTS API?
Q10.rec: Any authenticated session client may call POST …/tts; Wonderstand is primary UX but API is not wonderstand-only.
